scope: Offline decomposition of one shortest path per saved candidate point comparison. All 35 point costs and reconstructed path sums match preserved results. Road time includes v2 anchor connectors and rounding; local time includes assumed 25 km/h travel without roads. Nearest source distances use a local planar projection followed by haversine distance, within a 0.75-degree segment window; they diagnose these regional endpoints only. References are static models, not real-world truth. No national accuracy or real-world ETA claim is made.
